yes please, that would be great
Yes! Yes! This is needed please!

The problem with World Immobile is that it only "ignores" the positional values of the scene root, but it relies on the rotational values of the scene root. Setting it to all motion "fixes" the problem but then you won't have physics unless the physbone collides or is grabbed then released. Having the physics be based on parent/local offsets instead of world/scene offsets is preferred. Magica Cloth is capable of doing this with it's bone cloth scripts, and can even have the physics be based more on the animation values over moving the scene root. This would be something VRChat would have to overhaul but that could happen later for either new editions to Physbones 1.1 or have it for Physbones 1.2
I would love for this to be looked at, a much needed update to our current Physbones.

details:
As it is now, there is only one immobile setting available for physbones and you have to choose whether it affects  motion in scene space and playspace ("all motion") or scene space only ("world only").
Physbone components like ears and breasts need "soft" settings for realistic motion in playspace but those settings often cause them to flap around wildly when moving in scene space (using the joystick).  Providing two separate immobile values would allow users to dial in their physbone motion in playspace and then set a high immobile value for scene space movement to stop the wild "flapping in the wind" effect you get with soft physbones.
As it is now, there is no way to set a high immobile value for scene space to stop the flapping and also have a non-zero immobile value for playspace.
Please give us two separate immobile values, one for playspace and one for scene space so that I can set my playspace immobile low to fine tune "soft" bones and my scene space immobile high to stop those soft bones from flapping like crazy when moving with the joystick.
title: Physbone immobile world and playspace as separate settings
